Needs changes before merge.

The trial merge with `upstream/main` (`971c23faa026865be47e425a660439f8c3d17ecd`) is clean. The PR already contains that main commit.

What looks good:

- The three new tests pass. They cover importer paths, fixture directories, helper modules, and formatted paths.
- The selection keeps the existing suites.
- The body has `Process change: yes`. The PR does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`.
- No geometry, posted G-code, collision check, stock simulation, UI, or golden file changes.

Local results:

- `cargo --config 'env.CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE="1"' xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed.
- `cargo --config 'env.CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE="1"' xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. All 174 unit tests passed.
- Integration tests passed: `catalog` (4), `docs_images` (4), `example_line_endings` (1), `merge_ready_skill` (3), `merge_review` (6), `post_merge_concurrency` (1), and `review_artifacts` (3).
- The catalog test built the CLI locally. The quick gate finished in 299 seconds.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: passed.

Requested before merge:

1. `xtask/src/fixture_inputs.rs:75`: Include library tests in the scan for fixture readers. `scan::binaries` visits integration tests only. The helper can add only `--test` targets. For a fixture-only change, nothing selects the library tests. Existing readers include `crates/app/src/geometry/import/step_pass_tests.rs:12` and `crates/ui/src/launch_file_tests.rs:21`. I ran two isolated dry-run probes with the unchanged crate sources. One changed only `testdata/models/box.step`. The other changed only `testdata/models/bspline_discontinuous.step`. Both selected integration readers, but neither selected the app or UI library tests. Thus, a changed fixture can still bypass tests that read its directory. Scan library test sources and select the affected `--lib` targets. Add a selection test for this case.

Extra suites run:

- None beyond the quick gate. This diff changes no test data, fixture, golden, or importer source. The extra suite rules do not apply.
- The two dry-run probes checked fixture selection. Both confirmed the omission described above.

Mutations: none. This PR is outside the safety tier. No PR code was changed during this review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Library fixture readers were missing from quick-gate selection. The scanner now follows declared library modules and selects affected `--lib` targets. Existing integration readers remain selected.

Pinned by:
- `fixture_only_changes_select_library_readers_and_keep_integration_readers`
- `changed_box_fixture_selects_real_library_readers`
- `changed_bspline_fixture_selects_real_library_readers`

All three tests failed with the production fix reverted and passed after restoration.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed. All 177 unit tests and the integration tests passed. `cargo clippy -j 6 -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
